edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults exposed to traffic-related black carbon
edges.mechanism: Black-carbon exposure tracks with high oxidative and inflammatory particle burden, which can raise death risk across cardiovascular and respiratory pathways.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2024 Karimi meta analysis in J Environ Health Sci Eng already points to black carbon exposure tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
